items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: And that was my first recording, was with Ernie Wilkins.

ctx.x: And that was my first recording, was with Ernie Wilkins. But I spotted Gil Evans one night when I was playing with Mingus at the Five Spot. I thought oh, here’s my chance — it’s been two years and I haven’t been able to find this guy. So I put my instrument up and came back out and he had left. I said oh no is it going to be another two years before I see him? But he called me about a couple of weeks later because he’d gotten my number from Mingus.
Well he knew how to deal with the potential clash between the bass and the tuba it seems.
